scope: Private source-only CPU-held WFSYS native binding; no active integration, CI, SMC, DRAM, ROM, USB or device operation
result: PASS for private native-binding design and host model; linked XNU build and hardware behavior remain unverified
findings: Candidate sweet_touch differs from the prior AP-wake candidate only by two WFSYS includes after the wake include and one nwsa_after_persistent call after successful npa_persistent_window retention. The WFSYS entry is reached after phase10 and before the unchanged outer retained return; default-off nord2wifiwfsys != 1 exits before mappings, MMIO or logs.

A fresh static nwsa object owns this transaction. Its software-only owner requires persistent lifetime, outer_retained, entered/retained phase10/handoff2, no old fatal/halt/semaphore/SPI command, saved input/AP ownership and all required mapped handles. It rejects nawa active or previously entered; a planned image omitting nord2wifiwake avoids reusing the earlier asleep one-shot object. Neither the new owner nor callback paths call old npa/ncc terminal MMIO predicates or mutate npa state.

Raw PA switch resolves AP SPM 10006304/616c/6170 to nw.spm, infra 10001228/1724 to nw.infra, GALS 1020e504 to nw.gals; HOST 18060000/184/1a0/1a4/2cc/2d4, CFG 18001000/1620/1624/1c14, RGU 18000000/08/10/14/18, AFE 18003008, debug 1800f004 and semaphore 18072050/72250 all reuse persistent pages with p&0xfff offsets. Only BRCM 1800e000 and local WFSYS 184b0000 pages are newly mapped, with local version at +0x10. Mapping the local page does not itself read it before the core's powered stage.

Raw read rejects semaphore release address; raw write accepts only reviewed controls, rejects status/local ID writes, requires keyed WFSYS top word and forbids WFSYS CPU reset bit0=1. The stage-aware core/adapter further constrain source RMW values, semaphore ownership and access order. Native writes use NCC_DEVICE_BARRIER. No CONN/MCIF DRAM aperture, MPU SET, ROM buffer or firmware CPU-release operation is reachable through this binding.

On failure after an uncertain transaction, retained AP/WF/semaphore/clock/power flags or core halt/dirty/unverified cause manual-reset panic without cleanup or replay. Clean pre-mutation refusal can report a skipped/status line and leave the retained common owner alone. Successful final AP sleep is followed only by five bounded software-state log lines; no post-sleep raw MMIO or guard is called. Reentry panics before new I/O.

Host ASan/UBSan build of actual wifi_wfsys_bind.inc with frozen core/adapter passed. It exercises default-off zero mappings/I/O, wrong persistent owner, old nawa entered conflict, exact two new maps and ordered CPU-held cycle, old npa object byte-preservation, final no-I/O-after-sleep, reentry, explicit CPU-release rejection and local-ID timeout retention. The core/adapter suite separately passed 1290 injected callback failure positions.
limits: The host model is not a live peripheral or a linked XNU build. It does not establish the real semiconductor's protection/power acknowledgments or current ROM reservation/MPU/cache permission.

Success is the selected CPU-held WFSYS power-off subset, not byte-exact register restoration: VDNR remains set and FW_WIFI top-clock release is intentionally omitted because this diagnostic never acquired that resource.
The exact future native image must retain the separate nord2wifiwfsys=1 opt-in with old nord2wifiwake omitted, and requires its own build verification, image identity, review and boot authorization.
